flaws_detected_in_v14_2.description: Legacy cache check returned RENDER_CACHED_OK based solely on build/preview.mp4 > 50KB without validating SHA256 fingerprints of storyboard, voice, timeline, or renderer code modules.
Cross-project evidence fallback permitted Medieval/Samurai tests to fall back to Roman MP4 and format tests to fall back to V14.1 artifacts.
Historical backtest executed node render.mjs --check --scale 0.25 (dry-run syntax check) but misreported it as 'Re-rendered & Verified'.
Audit was computed from plan_camera_sequence data instead of actual decoded video frames and camera logs, reporting frontal_shots_count=0 despite frontal shots appearing in contact sheets.
Concurrency gate used asyncio.sleep(0.05) dummy tasks rather than verifying two actual concurrent video render processes.
Repetitive over-the-shoulder (OTS) viewpoints (6/22 shots) and giant foreground helmets obstructing scene readability.
Existing films are 77s test narratives; no genuine 480-600s (8-10 min) production film exists yet.
Fixed coordinates and static hero positions in offline fallback; lacking continuous character bible across multi-shot sequences.
Hardcoded 'lab/treadmill' music heuristics from legacy templates; missing clear distinction between real licensed SFX and procedural synthesis.
DEFAULT_MIN_DISK_GB was 2.0GB, insufficient for multi-minute 1080p rendering runs on a host with ~19GB free disk.
